name: desktop-worker-port
goal: Keep one automatically selected Desktop browser port across the runner, server and worker processes without adopting another server

evidence: Full ordinary check at 70fc3435d passed root, package, Reports, Planning and Desktop unit/native/build checks, then 203 of 204 browser cases failed with connection refusal at changing worker ports. Config chose a new free port in each process.

The standard preview refusal matrix covered explicit ports and foreign-server refusal but never auto-selected ports across processes. Extend it with fresh parent/worker configuration imports in both modes and a real ordinary read-only browser smoke flow.
At 05a299df9 both modes fail the same assertion: fresh worker imports choose different base URLs from their parent. The four existing named-port and foreign-server controls remain passing.

Publish the selected port in the runner environment before workers spawn, while preserving explicit-port validation, server port forwarding and reuseExistingServer=false. Keep the cross-process matrix and real ordinary smoke flow in normal verification.
